steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Enemy sighted! She's got steel claws—

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: That's one.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You took a Sarkaz down with just one hit? Not bad, Feline. You in the Victorian Army?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Stuff it!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You're strong, not like those Dublinn weaklings. Very well, Feline, you're worthy of dying by my blade!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: —Watch out!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Let's not jump to conclusions about who's dying by whose blade just yet.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Ahh—

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Sarkaz, you can't imagine how much I want to end your life right now... Too bad my sword is broken, thanks to your friend there.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Dagda, snap out of it!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I know what you're thinking. You want revenge, right? This isn't the time. We promised the Doctor we'd make a ruckus, draw the enemies here, and then leave—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Heh... Feline, you've killed a Sarkaz or two before! Your life... a Sarkaz will claim your life one day!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I don't care about my life all that much.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: If it was up to me, I wouldn't have run away from you people.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: What's gotten into you? You aren't even dodging their Arts!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I can take a few more Sarkaz down before I die...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I shouldn't have brought you here... Don't forget, Vina's still waiting for you down below!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: If you want to die, suit yourself, but don't get the Doctor and Amiya killed! You'd bring shame to Vina's name!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Fine. Morgan, tell me. How much longer do we need to hold them?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Five minutes. Then the Doctor said someone would be here to pick us up.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: There's a fight up ahead.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Right, don't know who they are, but looks like they beat us to the bunch, fighting the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Blake, do you remember how I said I got away from Dublinn?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: You said someone helped you...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Right. I didn't see his face, but I knew he's strong. So strong that he could walk into their campground alone even though there were hundreds of them.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Oh? If he was that strong, why'd he need such a ruckus?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It's not necessarily him, but he definitely isn't alone. There's a team who've been fighting Dublinn and the Sarkaz in Sudean.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Blake, I've never been so sure—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We aren't the only resistance members left. We... still have friends out there, spreading fire under the night sky.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Should we go help them, then?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: No, we can't change our objective just yet.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Let's move up and sneak inside while our friends have the Sarkaz distracted.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn! There's a Dublinn team closing in on you. Watch out! Their leader is... is...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Mandragora.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Soldier.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: A fire...?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Right. They reported to me they heard fighting just now.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Hm. Where are the guards?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Most of them are still here. They haven't been drawn away yet.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: I knew it... They came prepared.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Should we proceed, then?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Let's watch the fire outside for the time being. Our operation has begun.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Have everyone get ready.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Remember. This is our only chance.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hey you! What's this? Did you break the factory's machinery?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Who let you in here... It's you?!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Hello there.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Heh, I knew you were planning something. Get over here!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Whatever I, of all people, might be planning shouldn't mean anything to a warrior like you.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Ever since the Steam Knights vanished without a trace, and the Knights of the Tower fell one after another, how many warriors are there in Londinium... no, all of Victoria, worthy of your attention?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What's with the flattery all of a sudden, Feline? Trying to get me to let my guard down? You underestimate the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You're right. I can't kill you tonight. Not yet. But that's not going to stop me from sticking this arrowhead against your throat.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Ngh...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: A pampered, high-class lady like you is going to bleed with just a little scratch to your throat, I'm sure.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Haha, I'll let you stand here and watch your friends die one by one. By next morning, you'll've bled completely dry too—

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: If... If my blood will satisfy you...

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Take this!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Ahhhh! W-What is this?! My eyes! It burns!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Ugh––!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Lady, are you alright?!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: It's just a scratch. It'll stop bleeding soon.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Did you see that? The Sarkaz fell for it! The reagent you told me to keep actually worked!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Let's have him lay down here for a little. Just taking his crossbow and knocking him out almost broke my hand...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: The Sarkaz are a hardy bunch. If their eyes weren't always full of blood and hatred, he would've noticed you sneaking up to him.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Never mind... Benny, how is everyone else doing?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: We did what you said and took over the factory. We probably won't be able to hold it for too long, though. The Sarkaz are on their way, and they won't fall for this twice.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: We'd better hurry, then.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, they're here.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Which entrance?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: All three are under attack.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I'm not surprised.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: What about the Dublinn forces?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They're fighting the rebels.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Where's Mandragora?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We haven't seen their leader.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I see. Perhaps she'd be interested in what is about to take place here.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: What about Hoederer?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'm here.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I thought you were meant to guard the southwest entrance?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Before I head back to the fight, there is one thing I have to tell you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: *cough*... hah...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: An injured mercenary... Who is he?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: His name is Schwab. We had some dealings with each other, but he betrayed me, leading to some unexpected hiccups.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Betrayed...? That's an awfully terrible way to put it. Hoederer... Have you forgotten who you are?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Maybe you're the one who's forgotten himself, Schwab.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We're mercenaries... Hah... we've never been... anything else.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Hoederer, she's here... I haven't told her about you... Now don't you see what a great friend I am? Haha... I really can't wait to see... the look on your faces...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I have no idea what you are talking about.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I have no need to listen to a traitor talk.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Manfred—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Hoederer, you needn't explain anything.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: All I need to know is if you still serve me.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: No question there.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Good, then. I have a new mission for you.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock, Johnny, Gabby... All of you landed? Good.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Phew... We've made it in. Doctor, are you doing okay?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Sorry, I haven't ever had a passenger, and all I could think about was what if the grappling hook couldn't support the two of us.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: That's why I had to hold you so tight.

options: I thought you'd be more dependable.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure, can you see what's going on inside?

steps.name: Drone
steps.text: I can see everything no problem, Amiya. Even the fur in your ears...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: *Cough*, why is your drone so close?! I-It's too loud!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Besides... Why can I hear you speaking through it? Why aren't we using the comms?

steps.name: Drone
steps.text: The comms could be bugged! I mean, you said Sarkaz commander's a real smart cookie!

steps.name: Drone
steps.text: Not my Cloclo-1651 though. It's running an all-new security system. That's right. The one I was installing on the whole ship before we left...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Cloclo-1651?

steps.name: Drone
steps.text: Uh... Rockrock...? You don't mind, right? I kind of took some inspiration from your drones...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: It's okay. I like the name... It's cute.

steps.name: Drone
steps.text: Awesome!

steps.name: Drone
steps.text: Cloclo-... uh, some number... start scanning! Our target—Heidi Thomson!

steps.name: Drone
steps.text: Target... The target's not far off. The target... Crap! Sarkaz troops! Enemies closing in!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone, be careful. Get ready to fight!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What are you people doing here?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Are you... rebels? Like a finfish caught in a net... Haha!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Miss Amiya, there are a dozen Sarkaz behind him!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Rock-17—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let me do it.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Black lines—You're the Cautus!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Warrior.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will ask you this. Are you willing to surrender?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Surrender...? Cautus, what kind of joke is that?! Just watching you wield this power makes me sick to my stomach!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I'll never let you touch my emotions!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You've seen Arts like this before?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Don't make me laugh! All the Sarkaz here have seen it before!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I'd like to kill you myself... but before that, I have to tell the general...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Uh, someone attacked him from behind? A crossbow bolt... Where from?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Rock-17, aim!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Hello, my Self-Salvation Corps friends, and also... my Rhodes Island friends whom I haven't met.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Good evening, everyone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lady... Heidi?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: That's right. We meet at last, Miss Amiya.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: I don't have time to explain. Doctor... You're the Doctor, right? You're exactly as Kal'tsit described.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Yes... even your reaction is about what I expected. Doctor, have you thought through how we'll make it out of here?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Over here! They're here! Come—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Urghh—

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Quiet down, Sarkaz. I won't let you draw the other fighters here that quickly.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Thanks, Benny. Where are the others?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Milady, we've taken the factory on the south side.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: The methods you taught us are working really well... Even the frailest weavers are managing to fight off the Sarkaz guards.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Everyone's using the tools and machines they're familiar with, after all.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: These factories are ours, Benny. The Sarkaz can't control everything here as easily as they thought.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lady Heidi... I never expected you to be such a formidable fighter.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Miss Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please, call me Amiya. Just like Dr. Kal'tsit does.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Okay, Amiya.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Kal'tsit taught me a lot of things...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: And yes, that includes fighting.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Too bad I wasn't her best student.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: I was never able to help her with much.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: But I will do my absolute best to help Rhodes Island in this battle, just as I fought alongside the Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Another team of Sarkaz soldiers is coming our way.

steps.name: Drone
steps.text: Right, I don't want to be a killjoy... but things are pretty tense right now. There's not just one team... Uh, it looks like all the Sarkaz fighters in the factory are coming our way.

options: They know they lost the building.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Right, Doctor. We did our best, but this bought us very little time.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: That's why I need you to think of a way to get out of this right now...

options: A friend of ours should be here soon.
He's waiting on the east side already.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: A friend...?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: And 'he...?'

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Is it just a single man? Or a whole team?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Doctor, the Sarkaz soldiers that Manfred trained are very hard to deal with. They could be hiding anywhere... We mustn't let our guard down.

steps.name: Drone
steps.text: Everyone, I... I'm seeing something really strange! It's way too weird! The Sarkaz up ahead are fighting... Uh, I mean, they're fighting other Sarkaz.

steps.name: Drone
steps.text: Wait, are those... Sarkaz mercs?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: It's the strange mercenaries... One of them seemed to have lent us a hand this afternoon, too.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Sarkaz mercenaries?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: No, we can't trust them! They're the ones who took Bill this afternoon... *cough*! I...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Soldier
steps.text: Rockrock, calm down. You're still wounded.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I'm fine, but I can't say that about Bill!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Captain, help me out... They need to understand.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Lady Heidi, you said the Sarkaz mercenaries helped you. Could you be more specific about that?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: It was like they were sending me a signal...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: But I wasn't entirely sure...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: What kind of signal?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: All these Victorian soldiers... Should we kill them?

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Bloody Dublinn! I'll...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Captain, why aren't you attacking?

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn! Why are you stopping me? Have you forgotten how many of our brothers and sisters died at their hands?
Before she casts her Originium Arts, the Dublinn Caster always raises her hands.
It was those hands and that staff that took Cello's life... as well as the lives of many other Victorian soldiers.
Horn puts her hand on the crossbow she hid up in her sleeve.
If Mandragora shows any signs of lifting even a single finger, she will immediately pull the trigger.
Or perhaps... she could just pull the trigger now. That doesn't seem like a bad choice either.
She can tell from her opponent's eyes that she is thinking the exact same thing.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What's going on? The southern zone's blown up? You mean, the entire wall? It could only be done from the inside... Dammit!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hurry, let's back them up—

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Is this the signal for us to evacuate?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Uh... The Doctor never told me anything... but since the Sarkaz are gone, I guess our mission is over?
You two should go on ahead.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You're with Rhodes Island...
I'm taking over from here.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Captain, the Sarkaz evacuated! This is the perfect opportunity! Should we head inside or...?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Let's go.
Horn does not take her hand off her crossbow. Her glare closely follows Mandragora as she leaves.

A single bolt. From this distance, that's all it would take. All she has to do is pull the trigger, and her opponent's chest would be torn open, splattering blood everywhere, just like what happened to Cello.
Having retrofitted this crossbow herself, Horn knows its limits very well, but they're so close to each other. With the two of them now within a hair's distance...

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn, they're gone.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: I was really worried about controlling myself, Horn... Thanks for holding me back. You're right. We shouldn't fight Dublinn here.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: If we actually started fighting each other, the Sarkaz would've found us.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: I'm surprised Mandragora could hold herself back, though. She was hounding us like crazy... What are they doing?
What is Dublinn doing?
Horn refuses to analyze this question. Her fingertips are still from the boiling blood. Why didn't she pull the trigger?
Why didn't Mandragora raise her hand?
These voices are clashing in her chest. She can feel a clear sense of regret.
But she can't say that.
That's not what her men want to hear.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Forget Mandragora. She's not our objective.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Okay, Horn. What should we do now? Follow Dublinn inside?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Everyone, we're cancelling our original plan. From here on out, we will stay dark.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Blake, you'll continue to be point man. If you run into any Sarkaz guards, take them down. Robben, you'll follow Blake and provide fire support when necessary.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Everyone else, follow me.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Do you see the opening up ahead? Our Dublinn friends left us that. We should take advantage of it when they're dealing with our enemies.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Remember, we came as a team of five, so we'll leave as a team of five. No... We'll leave this Sarkaz prison with even more of our friends.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Watch my hand signal—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Move out!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: *Cough*... *cough*... What was that explosion? Miss Closure. That wasn't you, was it?

steps.name: Drone
steps.text: Error—Error—Restarting—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Err, it wasn't her. She wouldn't have blown up her own drone.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Doctor, is this part of your plan? It's a little... flashy, isn't it?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, is it...?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Look, someone's walking past the dust! It's... It's another Sarkaz! Rock-17—
Again with the weapons? Not to mention... More fresh meat?
{@nickname}, is this how you always greet your heroes?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Is this Sarkaz one of yours...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Miss Rockrock, please keep your weapon trained on her.
C'mon, little bunny. It's been aaages! Are you really so heartless? That hurts... it cuts deep, you know?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Feist, please check for any Originium explosives in our immediate vicinity.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No time. We have people to rescue...
Aw man, what a shame. Looks like we don't have time for proper hellos.
C'mere, Heidi.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: You're here for me?
Hey now, can't you at least sound a little more enthusiastic? We only just met, and it's not like you're the biggest fan of {@nickname} anyway.
If it wasn't for that stinking old bitch... the one you love ever so much, asking me to come get you, I wouldn't be here either.
Ask any Sarkaz here, I don't come cheap.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Kal'tsit sent you?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: A Sarkaz mercenary... an explosives expert...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Are you... W?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Whoa, she told you about me? Should I be breaking down in tears of joy? Look at that, out of all my old friends running around, there's actually somebody who still cares about me.
